svg.title: One practice session, from credential to lesson report
svg.desc: The browser asks the API for a live session. The API checks the owner and the monthly voice quota under a per-user lock, closes any other open session, builds the tutor's instructions on the server from the scenario and the learner's profile, and asks the provider for a short-lived credential with those instructions inside. The browser connects to the provider (OpenAI through the API's SDP relay, Gemini directly with a locked ephemeral token) and the conversation runs. When the session ends the API books server-measured seconds, and the browser posts its transcript. A worker job writes the lesson report with the text model, or with the built-in offline engine when none is configured.
svg.text: One practice session, from credential to lesson report
POST /practice/:id/live
owner check, quota under a per-user lock,
close any other open session, build the
instructions from the scenario and profile, record
a live_sessions row with max_seconds
mint: tutor instructions + end_session tool locked in
ek_... secret or ephemeral token
LiveSessionGrant (no provider key)
OpenAI: SDP offer to /api/realtime/openai/calls
relayed once; call id recorded
live audio both ways (Gemini: WebSocket, no relay)
the tutor role-plays, corrects gently, then calls end_session
POST .../live/:sid/end
hang up (OpenAI); seconds measured on the server
POST /practice/:id/end { transcript }
job lesson.report (one per session)
text model, or the offline engine, writes
summary, corrections, vocab, 5 drills, 4 scores;
a silent session gets the floor scores
Client-sent scores and instructions are rejected. The report is written by the server from the transcript.
